'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kingery DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' You Killed My Father, Prepare To Die!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
